title: Stop planning and post

scenes.say: Your plan is not the problem.
scenes.visual: a wall covered in sticky notes and diagrams in a dim room
a man staring at a blank laptop screen, hand on chin

scenes.say: Nobody can buy what they have never seen.
scenes.visual: a closed shop with the shutters down on an empty street

scenes.say: Post the work. Show the product. Say what you do.
scenes.visual: a hand holding a phone and filming a product on a table
a man setting a phone on a small tripod on a desk

scenes.say: Attention goes to the people who keep showing up.
scenes.visual: a crowd of people walking down a busy city street at dusk

scenes.say: Follow for more. Build every day.
scenes.visual: shutters rolling up on a shop front at sunrise

caption: Nobody can buy what they have never seen. Post the work.
